findings.location: Product titles, breadcrumbs, and sidebar category links
findings.issue: The blue link text (approximately #337ab7) on white (#ffffff) and light grey (#f5f5f5) backgrounds has a contrast ratio of ~3.4:1, failing the WCAG AA minimum requirement of 4.5:1 for text under 18pt.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision or those viewing the site on screens with low contrast/high glare will struggle to read the navigation categories and product titles.
findings.recommendation: Update the primary brand link color to a darker shade of blue (such as #1a5380 or #23527c) to ensure a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio across all light background variants.

findings.location: Product card titles (e.g., 'A Light in the ...')
findings.issue: Product titles are prematurely truncated with ellipses to a single line, even though there is ample vertical space to wrap the text below.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot read the full titles of the products directly from the catalog page, requiring them to hover or navigate away to identify the items.
findings.recommendation: Allow product titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines, using a min-height or fixed height for the title container to maintain vertical alignment across the row.

findings.issue: Book cover images have varying aspect ratios and heights, causing inconsistent vertical alignment and uneven blank space above the star ratings.
findings.user_impact: The uneven layout looks unpolished and disrupts the alignment of secondary details (like ratings and prices) across product rows.
findings.recommendation: Set a fixed height on the image wrapper container (e.g., 210px) and apply 'object-fit: contain' to the images to preserve their aspect ratios while standardizing the container footprint.
